about: Feature list and backlog for agent sessions. One entry = one user-visible capability with acceptance criteria and the checks that prove it. Agents pick work from here and change `status` only after the listed checks ran in the same session.

status_values.passing: acceptance criteria hold; the listed checks passed at `verified.at`
status_values.failing: a listed check fails or a criterion is known to be broken
status_values.unverified: built, but no automated check covers the criteria yet

rules: Never mark a feature passing without running its checks in the current session.
Never delete or weaken acceptance criteria or tests to make a feature pass; change criteria only with the owner's approval, noted in harness/progress.md.
`e2e` lists browser steps that are not automated yet; they are verified manually (or with the browser-verifier agent) and do not count toward `passing`.

features.title: Season race calendar
acceptance: /zavody lists the races of the current season with date, venue and registration status in words
Races with open registration take precedence over date in the race status shown
Past races are marked as finished
e2e: Open /zavody, check that the next race has a status badge with text

features.title: Race detail with documents
acceptance: /zavod/:raceId shows date, venue, categories, attachments (propozice, výsledky) and registered racers
Only published documents are downloadable
e2e: Open a race detail, download the propozice PDF

features.title: Online race registration
acceptance: A parent can register a racer for a race with open registration
Existing racers are matched by name and birth year instead of duplicated
Category is derived from birth year and season
Registration is refused when registration is closed
e2e: Register a new racer on the test environment, confirm it appears in admin Registrations

features.title: Results and season standings
acceptance: /vysledky shows race results and cup standings per category for a chosen season
Standings points are computed consistently with the competition rules (tests encode them)
Results and standings export to PDF
e2e: Open /vysledky, switch season, download the standings PDF

features.title: Live timing page
acceptance: /zive shows live results while a race runs and a calm state otherwise
Header LivePill and LiveBand appear only during a live race
e2e: Start a race in the timekeeper on the test environment, check /zive updates

features.title: News, documents, contacts, privacy
acceptance: /aktuality and /archiv-zprav list published posts only; drafts and their attachments are not reachable by id
/dokumenty lists published season documents
/kontakty and /ochrana-osobnich-udaju render

features.title: SEO and sharing metadata
acceptance: Every public route has a title, description and OG image; sitemap lists races

features.title: Shared admin/timekeeper login
acceptance: One JWT covers admin and timekeeper sections; logout clears both
Admin endpoints require role admin; timekeeper endpoints accept admin and timekeeper
Admin UI refuses a timekeeper-role account without logging it out of the timekeeper
e2e: Log in as timekeeper, open /admin, expect refusal; open /timekeeper, still logged in

features.title: Seasons and current season
acceptance: Admin creates seasons and flags exactly one as current; the public site follows the flag

features.title: Races, categories, clubs, racers CRUD
acceptance: Admin creates, edits and deletes races, categories, clubs and racers
Editing a racer's birth year recomputes the category
Club requests from the public form can be approved or rejected

features.title: Registrations overview
acceptance: Admin sees and edits registrations per race and exports them

features.title: Document library with systematic file names
acceptance: Uploaded attachments get a systematic name from their owner (e.g. JMLP2025-05_propozice.pdf) with collision suffixes
The library is a flat, filterable table; files can be renamed (extension kept)
Bulk download as ZIP mirrors owners as folders
Missing files on disk are reported, not crashed on

features.title: Posts (news) editor
acceptance: Admin writes, publishes and unpublishes posts with an image and a document

features.title: Start list and bib numbers
acceptance: Timekeeper builds the start list from registrations, assigns bib numbers by set/colour, excludes racers
Late entries can be added, also offline (temporary negative id, remapped on sync)
Start list prints to PDF

features.title: Entering times (manual and timing device)
acceptance: Times for run 1/2 and DNF/DNS/DSQ are saved per racer
Timing-device impulses arrive over Web Serial into a durable inbox and are matched to bibs
A typed but not yet saved value survives reload (drafts)
On a revision conflict the safe choice (keep server value) has focus; Enter never overwrites another device's value
e2e: Feed impulses through a virtual serial port and confirm them to bibs (simulator not in repo yet)

features.title: Offline-first operation and sync
acceptance: All core screens work with the server unreachable (race detail, start list, timing, late entries, results)
Mutations queue in IndexedDB and replay in order with idempotency keys; duplicates are ignored by the backend
Stale writes get 409 and are parked as conflicts, not lost
Connectivity is real server reachability, not navigator.onLine
e2e: Load a race, go offline in DevTools, enter 3 times and a late entry, reload, go online, confirm all synced once
features.notes: Unit coverage is strong; the end-to-end offline scenario is the top candidate for the first Playwright test (HAR-04).

features.title: Local backup export/import
acceptance: All local race data, including unconfirmed timing-device events, exports to a file and imports back without duplicates

features.title: Results and SLČR export
acceptance: Race results by category print to PDF
Results export to the national federation format (FIS XML / SLČR evidence)

features.title: Modrá stopa kit and style rules
acceptance: Every screen is built from components/ms; no Bootstrap, legacy variables, hex colours or emoji in modules
Timekeeper routes do not overflow horizontally between 600 and 1366 px
e2e: Resize timekeeper routes to 600, 768, 1024, 1366 px and check for horizontal page scroll
features.notes: The 600-1366 px overflow rule is checked by hand only; candidate for an automated Playwright viewport test.

features.title: Agent conventions, guardrails and session loop
acceptance: AGENTS.md is the canonical entry point; CLAUDE.md files import it
Hooks block production-touching and secret-reading commands
harness/init.sh and harness/verify.sh run green on a clean checkout

features.title: Playwright end-to-end suite in the repo
acceptance: e2e/ with @playwright/test runs against a disposable stack, never the shared test environment's data
First scenarios: offline timekeeper day (TK-03), registration (PUB-03), timekeeper viewport overflow (UI-01)
harness/verify.sh e2e runs it

features.title: CI pipeline
acceptance: GitHub Actions run lint, style rules, frontend tests, build, backend tests on MySQL and the harness self-test on every pull request to dev or main
The ruleset requires the frontend, backend and harness checks before merge
features.notes: Becomes passing after the first green run on GitHub and the required checks are set in the ruleset.

features.title: Harness evals
acceptance: A small suite of task prompts runs headless (claude -p) in a clean worktree
Each task is scored by its own checks (tests pass, guard rules respected, diff scope) with cost and duration recorded
Results are comparable across model and harness changes
